preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is a positive integer within the range [1, 10^5].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**5 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line) <= 10**5])
preconditions.description: Each test case has an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5) representing the length of the permutations.

preconditions.expression: all(len(a) == n and set(a) == set(range(1, n + 1)) for a in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit() and len(line.split()) == n])
preconditions.description: Each permutation a is a list of n distinct integers from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(len(b) == n and set(b) == set(range(1, n + 1)) for b in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit() and len(line.split()) == n])
preconditions.description: Each permutation b is a list of n distinct integers from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(len(d) == n and all(di == 0 or di == a[i] or di == b[i] for i, di in enumerate(d)) for d in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit() and len(line.split()) == n])
preconditions.description: Each d is a list of n elements where each element is either 0, a[i], or b[i].

preconditions.expression: all(set(d) == set(range(1, n + 1)) or any(di == 0 for di in d) for d in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit() and len(line.split()) == n])
preconditions.description: If d contains no zeros, it must be a permutation of 1 to n; otherwise, zeros indicate unknown values.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one result per test case.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line) <= 10**9 + 6 for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each result is a non-negative integer modulo 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line) == count_valid_c_permutations(a, b, d) % (10**9 + 7) for line, (a, b, d) in zip(stdout.splitlines(), test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output line is the count of valid permutations c modulo 10^9 + 7, where c is formed by choosing for each i either a[i] or b[i], and c is a permutation of 1 to n, and c[i] == d[i] when d[i] != 0.
